about.title: About
about.description: Itto-Ryu Tech: free Pine Script indicators, grown with patience.
about.tateGloss: meikyō shisui, a clear mirror, still water
about.h1Html:
A bonsai is not made
in a day.
about.sub: It is grown with patience and shaped by careful cuts. Trading is the same.
about.name1Html: The name borrows 一刀 (ittō), Japanese for “a single cut”. Here it means the one deliberate cut a gardener makes when shaping a tree.
about.name2Html: The guiding phrase 明鏡止水 (meikyō shisui, “a clear mirror, still water”) is a reminder that a still mind reads the chart more clearly.
about.name3: Itto-Ryu Tech is not affiliated with any Ittō-ryū school of swordsmanship, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TradingView.
about.kikoAlt: Kiko Ryu, the Itto-Ryu Tech mascot: a white fox sitting still with eyes closed, a vermilion mark on its brow and a bib carrying the logo, in front of a vermilion circle, two torii gates and rice stalks.
about.kikoBody: In Japanese folklore, white foxes serve Inari, the kami of rice. Rice is grown, not grabbed: planted, tended, then waited for. Kiko Ryu keeps that idea close: a still mind, written rules and the patience to let them work.
